spec.B0: original frozen325 ExtraTrees400; contemporaneous paired OOF reference

E0.purpose: compact capacity control and eligible candidate

E1.purpose: production-state representation, same estimator as E0

T1.purpose: stronger temporal shrinkage; only alpha changes100 to1000 from previous temporal-only branch

F75.purpose: fixed global complementarity, no per-well routing
F75.space: raw RCYL after individual inverse transforms

spec.target: log1p(RCYL/s); raw last legal RCYL finite>0 else1; no scale change
spec.state_scope: 6 calendar months up to cutoff; raw zeros valid; no RCYL/operating-fraction target correction; oil/liquid is an empirical ratio, not certified volumetric water cut
spec.minimum_valid: 3-month statistics require2;6-month statistics require4;slope requires3;latest requires actual latest; differences require both sides

research_CV: fixed5 and5repeated group5, seeds1..5; four actual learners x30=120 fits; F75 no extra fits
preprocessors: one top-level train-fitted pipeline per actual learner; separately counted; no diagnostic preprocessing fit
baseline_reproduction: all6 exact B0 reference scores within1e-9; fail stops before same-split new candidate
selection: among passing candidates maximize repeat_mean_delta - sample_std(repeat_deltas); tie fixed_delta then stable candidate order E0,E1,T1,F75; choose only one
saving: only selected candidate after confirmation all pass; one full model or twoF75 components; max4MiB combined; pending independent review, never auto replace
threshold_provenance: B prespecified engineering stable-improvement criteria, not user-quoted values or significance claim
error_analysis: six-split same-well error recurrence and paired state losses; topquartile errors>=4/6 exploratory stable-hard group; raw labels only retrospective diagnosis; group/cell privacy suppression; fixedOOF pairedwell bootstrap2000 descriptive only
parallelism: one model and fold at a time, ETn_jobs=-1, OMP/BLAS1, no new heavy dependencies or outside weights
